extName.message: Mass Friends Remover for Facebook — Bulk Unfriender

extDescription.message: Delete Facebook friends in bulk, remove selected people, or unfriend everyone. Fast, private, and fully local.

connectDescription.message: Your friends load straight into this panel using your signed-in Facebook session. No Facebook tab has to stay open.

sessionMissing.message: Sign in to Facebook to continue

loginDescription.message: Sign in to Facebook, then reopen this panel.

speedLockedHint.message: Unlock this speed with the unlimited upgrade.

speedHintFree.message: Slow and Normal keep Facebook comfortable. Fast and Ultra are part of the unlimited upgrade.

speedHintPaid.message: All speeds unlocked. Slower pacing is still the safest against Facebook rate limits.

selectToStart.message: Select the friends you want to remove

limitStoppedBatch.message: Free daily limit reached after $1 removals

quotaExplanation.message: The free plan removes up to 20 friends per day.

confirmDescription.message: Facebook does not offer an undo for this. You would have to send a new friend request to each person.

confirmCheckbox.message: I understand this cannot be undone

upgradeDescription.message: The free plan removes up to 20 friends per day at Slow or Normal speed. Upgrade for unlimited removals and the faster speeds.

dailyLimitDescription.message: The free plan removes up to 20 friends each day. Upgrade to clear your whole list in one go.

licenseInvalid.message: That license key is not active.

congratsMessage.message: You removed $1 friends. Your list is tidier already.

reviewDescription.message: A quick Chrome Web Store review helps more people find the extension.

errorNotLoggedIn.message: Sign in to Facebook, then press refresh.

errorNoToken.message: Could not read your Facebook session. Open Facebook once, then press refresh.

errorFacebookChanged.message: Your friends list can’t be read right now.

breakageBody.message: Your friends list can’t be read right now. This is not a problem with your account or your computer — Facebook changed how its pages work, and the extension needs a small update to keep up.

breakageHint.message: Let us know and we’ll fix it. Nothing about you or your friends is sent — only that this stopped working.

reportSent.message: Thanks — the developer has been notified.

reportFailed.message: Could not send just now. Please try again.
